appDescription.message: Play chess against Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Perplexity and Copilot from the side panel. No backend, 100% local.

connections_choosePin.message: Choose and pin one supported AI tab before sending a prompt.

connections_noTabs.message: No supported AI tabs open. Open one below, then refresh.

connections_pinLost.message: The pinned AI tab closed or left a supported host. Choose another tab; no prompt was sent.

connections_pinFailed.message: That tab could not be pinned. Open a supported AI chat and try again.

connections_unpinned.message: AI tab unpinned. Choose a tab before the next prompt.

controls_confirmSide.message: Start a NEW game as the other side? The current game will end.

controls_switchSideTitle.message: Start a new game as the other side

status_sideNewGame.message: You now play {color}. A new game has started.

status_paused.message: Companion paused. No prompts or observers are active.

status_resumed.message: Companion resumed. Ask the AI again when a reply is expected.

status_waitGeneration.message: Waiting for {platform} to finish generating… Do not press Enter.

status_manualSend.message: Copy the prompt, paste and send it yourself in the pinned AI tab. The reply will be watched.

status_manualCopied.message: Prompt copied. Paste and send it yourself in the pinned AI tab; waiting for your message.

status_generationTimeout.message: The model is still generating. No prompt was sent; copy it to send later.

status_verifyFailed.message: The full prompt was not in the composer. Nothing was sent. Copy it instead.

status_illegalReason.message: The AI answered [{move}]: {reason} Ask again to correct it.

status_aiResigned.message: The AI resigned. Start a new game to play again.

status_sendFailure.message: Could not send the prompt: {detail} Copy it instead.

match_stockfishNotice.message: Strength-limited Stockfish is GPL-3, runs locally, no network. Stockfish UCI_Elo scale, not FIDE.

match_paused.message: Stockfish stopped while paused. Resume to reload it.

match_noGames.message: No rated games yet. Complete a real game against the pinned chat AI.

match_requiresAuto.message: Rated matches require Auto send mode. Change it in AI settings.

match_requiresPin.message: Rated matches require one live pinned AI chat tab.

match_confirmReplace.message: Start a rated Stockfish match? This starts a NEW game and replaces the current board.

match_started.message: Rated game started. Chat AI plays {color}; Stockfish anchor {anchor}.

match_engineThinking.message: Stockfish is choosing a move at UCI_Elo {anchor}…

match_unratedProtocol.message: Protocol failed: game unfinished / unrated. No engine move replaced the AI.

match_pinLost.message: Pinned tab lost: match unfinished / unrated. Pin another chat to play.

match_storageError.message: Could not store the rated game. No estimate was updated.

match_finished.message: Rated game finished: {result}. See the estimate in Analysis.

match_running.message: Stop the rated match before loading a different game.

analysis_confirmEngine.message: Start a NEW local game against the heuristic engine? This replaces the current board.

analysis_engineMode.message: Local engine game started (strength 1–8, no Elo).

analysis_engineFailed.message: The local engine could not make a move.

illegal_opponent_piece.message: The piece on {from} belongs to the other side.

illegal_does_not_move_that_way.message: That piece cannot move from {from} to {to}.

illegal_leaves_king_in_check.message: That move would leave the king in check.

illegal_castle_rights.message: Castling rights or the required rook are missing.

illegal_castle_through_check.message: The king cannot castle out of, through, or into check.

illegal_en_passant_illegal.message: There is no legal en passant capture on that square.

illegal_promotion_required.message: A pawn reaching the last rank needs a promotion suffix (q, r, b or n).

illegal_promotion_illegal.message: Promotion is only allowed on a pawn move to the last rank.

illegal_not_in_legal_set.message: That move is not in the legal set for this position.

badge_pin.message: AI Chess Companion — pin an AI chat tab to play

badge_check.message: AI Chess Companion — {color} is in check

badge_white.message: AI Chess Companion — White to move

badge_black.message: AI Chess Companion — Black to move

status_timeoutCopied.message: The AI is still generating. The prompt was copied; nothing was sent.

status_awaitingUnpinned.message: It is {color}’s turn, but no AI chat is pinned. Pin one supported tab to continue.

outcome_insufficientMaterial.message: Draw — not enough material to mate. {result}

illegal_repeated_move.message: That move was already rejected in this position; choose a different legal move.

status_noAi.message: No AI chat detected. Open one of the supported AI chats to play.

status_check.message: You are in check — only legal escapes are shown.

status_nothingToUndo.message: There is nothing to undo yet.

status_gameOverNew.message: The game is over — start a new game to keep playing.

status_aiBelongs.message: That piece belongs to the AI.

status_selectPiece.message: Select one of your pieces first.

status_noLegalMoves.message: That piece has no legal moves.

status_copyFailed.message: Copying failed — your browser blocked clipboard access.

status_storageFull.message: Storage is full — delete old games to free space.

status_contentMissing.message: Content script not found — reload the AI tab to connect.

status_promptCopied.message: Prompt copied — paste it into the AI chat.

status_illegalAi.message: The AI answered [{move}], which is not legal here. Ask again or adjust the position.

status_couldNotReach.message: Could not reach the AI tab: {detail}

status_composerMissing.message: Could not find the chat input box on this page.

status_typeFailed.message: Could not type the chess prompt into the chat input box.

status_submitFailed.message: Could not submit the prompt. Send it manually to continue.

status_submitNotDispatched.message: Nothing was submitted — the chat accepted no send action. Copy it and send it yourself.

moves_empty.message: No moves yet. Play a white piece to start.

connections_hint.message: Prompts go only to the AI tab you pin. Nothing leaves your browser otherwise.

settings_autoRetry.message: Ask again when the AI answers an illegal move

settings_hint.message: Settings are stored locally. Nothing is uploaded.

analysis_hint.message: Local engine — heuristic evaluation, not perfect.

analysis_heuristicNote.message: This judgement is a heuristic estimate, not a perfect calculation.

status_submitUnconfirmed.message: One send attempt was made but could not be confirmed. Check the pinned chat before copying or sending anything.

status_stillWaiting.message: Still waiting for {platform} to answer. The prompt stays sent — nothing is resent.

status_loadCancelled.message: Loading cancelled — the current game was kept.

delivery_neverAttempted.message: The prompt was never sent — nothing was typed or clicked in the chat.

delivery_attempted.message: One send was attempted but could not be confirmed. Check the pinned chat first; only copy or send something if the message is missing there.

delivery_confirmed.message: The prompt was confirmed sent. Waiting for the chat to answer.

delivery_answered.message: The chat replied and its move was accepted on the board.

delivery_stale.message: An update from an older request arrived too late and was ignored.

controls_confirmNewGame.message: Start a NEW game? The current game will end.

controls_confirmReplaceGame.message: Replace the current game with this one?

firstRun_text.message: Pin one supported AI chat, pick a side, and make a move. The extension sends your position to that chat and plays its reply here. Settings holds everything else.

help_pinnedChat.message: The pinned AI chat plays your opponent: each legal move is sent there once, and only its new reply moves a piece.

help_localTools.message: Hint and Analyse run a small local engine for suggestions only — they never play for the chat AI.

help_rated.message: A rated match is separate: local Stockfish (UCI_Elo scale, not FIDE) plays one side against the chat AI, with its own history.

match_banner.message: RATED · Chat AI plays {chatColor} · Stockfish plays {engineColor} (UCI_Elo {anchor})

settings_confirmDestructive.message: Confirm before replacing a game or switching sides

settings_confirmDestructiveHint.message: Rated matches always ask for confirmation, even when this is off.

settings_reminderHint.message: Shows a quiet reminder while a reply is pending. It never resends the prompt or changes the result.

settings_funSentencesHint.message: Fun mode adds 1–2 short witty sentences after the move. The move is always parsed first.

battle_separation.message: Battles are UNRATED. Rated match records are never touched by a battle.

battle_manualMode.message: Battles need Auto send mode. Switch to Auto to start one.

battle_needsMainPin.message: Pin an AI tab first, then start the battle.

battle_pinFailed.message: Could not pin the opponent tab for the battle.

battle_pausedByUser.message: Battle paused. The clock is stopped.

battle_restored.message: Battle restored (paused). Resume when you are ready \u2014 nothing was sent.

battle_aborted.message: Battle aborted \u2014 unfinished, no ledger entry.

battle_deliveryContradicted.message: the composer showed a different message (contradiction) \u2014 nothing is sent with certainty, fail-closed.

battle_deliveryUnconfirmed.message: the send was never confirmed \u2014 nothing else was sent.

battle_deliveryUnreachable.message: the tab could not be reached.

battle_pausedIllegal.message: illegal or missing replies after {count} retries. Ask again, Abort, or Export.

battle_startCancelled.message: Battle not started — the current game was kept.

studio_empty.message: The preview is the exact prompt the send path would dispatch.

studio_overBudget.message: Over the 800-character budget — review before relying on it.

timeline_privacy.message: Stage timings only (ms deltas). Never message text, FENs or titles.

status_aiToMove.message: {platform} is to move — nothing has been sent yet. Press Ask AI to send the position.

settings_explainHint.message: Show a live-only reason after the move. Never saved.
